name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in college and universities.
applicationInstructions: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), submit Class 12 board marksheet and family income certificate issued by competent revenue authority.
requirements: Must have scored above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board exam
Pursuing regular (non-correspondence) degree in recognized college/university in India
Gross parental/family annual income not exceeding ₹4.5 Lakhs
Not availing any other government scholarship scheme

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India
description: A prestigious fellowship aimed at attracting bright young minds to natural and basic sciences at the Bachelor and Master level.
awardAmount: ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 cash + ₹20,000 summer project mentorship)
applicationInstructions: Submit online application via DST INSPIRE portal with Class 12 board advisory note, endorsement certificate from college principal, and SBI bank account details.
requirements: Top 1% rank in Class 12 Board examinations across India
Ranked in top 10,000 in JEE Advanced or NEET, pursuing B.Sc./B.S./Int. M.Sc.
Pursuing courses only in Natural and Basic Sciences (Engineering/Medicine excluded)
Age limit between 17 and 22 years

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
provider: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Attracting top talent for doctoral research in cutting-edge science and technology domains at premier Indian institutions (IITs, IISc, IISERs, NITs).
applicationInstructions: Apply via direct entry or lateral entry after securing admission to PhD at a PMRF granting institute (IITs, IISc, NITs). Require project abstract and recommendation.
requirements: Completed or in final year of B.Tech/Integrated M.Tech/M.Sc. at recognized institute
Minimum CGPA of 8.0 on a 10-point scale (or 75% marks)
Valid GATE score of at least 650 if qualifying degree is not from centrally funded technical institute
Admitted or recommended for PhD at PMRF Granting Institute

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
provider: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), NTU, NUS, SUTD
description: A collaboration between A*STAR, NTU, NUS, and SUTD to provide international students with PhD training in biomedical sciences, physical sciences, engineering, and computing.
awardAmount: Full tuition fees + Monthly stipend SGD $2,700 - $3,200 + One-time airfare grant SGD $1,500 + Settling-in allowance SGD $1,000
applicationInstructions: Submit online application through the A*STAR SINGA portal. Select research projects under A*STAR, NUS, NTU, or SUTD. Provide 2 academic recommendation letters and bachelor transcripts.
requirements: Open to all international graduates with passion for research and excellent academic results
Good skills in written and spoken English (GRE/IELTS/TOEFL optional but encouraged)
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant STEM disciplines
Strong academic references and demonstrable research aptitude

name: DAAD Study Scholarships for Postgraduate Studies in All Academic Disciplines
description: Prestigious scholarships for highly qualified international graduates from India to complete a full Master's degree course at a state-recognized German university.
awardAmount: €934/month living stipend + Full health, accident & personal liability insurance + Travel allowance + One-off study allowance
applicationInstructions: Apply via the DAAD Portal. Upload detailed CV in Europass format, Letter of Motivation (1-3 pages), degree certificate, and list of chosen Master degree courses in Germany.
requirements: Completed undergraduate Bachelor degree (e.g. B.Tech/B.Sc) at recognized university
Degree completion generally should not date back more than 6 years
Letter of motivation explaining academic and professional rationale for studying in Germany
English proficiency certificate (IELTS/TOEFL) for English-taught Master programs

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
description: World-class doctoral scholarship designed to attract and retain world-class doctoral students to Canadian universities (University of Toronto, UBC, Waterloo, McGill).
awardAmount: CAD $50,000 per year for up to 3 years
applicationInstructions: Candidates must be nominated by a Canadian institution holding a Vanier allocation. Apply through ResearchNet portal with 2 leadership reference letters and research proposal.
requirements: Nominated by only one Canadian institution with an institutional allocation
Pursuing first doctoral degree or combined MA/PhD, MD/PhD
Achieved a first-class average (e.g. > 80% or 3.7+ GPA) in each of the last two years of full-time study
Demonstrated significant leadership potential and scholarly research excellence

name: National University of Singapore (NUS) Graduate Research Scholarship
description: Awarded to outstanding graduate students for research leading to a higher degree (Master of Science by Research or PhD) in Computing and Engineering at NUS.
awardAmount: Full tuition fee subsidy + Monthly stipend SGD $2,200 - $2,800 (plus additional $500/mo after passing PhD Qualifying Exam)
applicationInstructions: Select 'NUS Research Scholarship' checkbox while submitting the graduate admission application for NUS School of Computing.
requirements: Graduates with passion for research and high academic achievement (at least 2nd Class Honours Upper / 8.0+ CGPA)
Eligible for admission to a full-time PhD or M.Sc by Research at NUS School of Computing or College of Design and Engineering
Good GRE and TOEFL/IELTS scores for international applicants

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate & Postgraduate Scholarships
description: One of India's largest private scholarship initiatives, supporting meritorious students across India to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in tech and innovation.
awardAmount: Up to ₹2,00,000 (UG) / Up to ₹6,00,000 (PG) across degree duration
applicationInstructions: Complete the online application form and take the mandatory 60-minute online cognitive and aptitude assessment.
requirements: Resident Indian citizen currently enrolled in full-time degree at accredited Indian university
Passed standard 12th / previous degree with a minimum of 60%
Household income preference under ₹2.5 Lakhs, eligible up to ₹15 Lakhs
Mandatory online aptitude assessment test

name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) & Trillium Scholarships
provider: Government of Ontario & Ontario Universities (Toronto, Waterloo, McMaster)
description: Merit-based scholarships for international students undertaking graduate studies at participating universities in Ontario, Canada.
applicationInstructions: Apply directly through the graduate studies award portal of the participating Ontario university where you hold an active admission application.
requirements: Enrolled in or applied to graduate studies at a participating Ontario university
Overall average of at least A- (80% or 3.7/4.0 GPA) in the last two completed years of study
Valid study permit in Canada upon enrollment

name: Chevening Scholarships
provider: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)
description: The UK government’s global scholarship programme, offering future leaders the opportunity to study a one-year Master’s degree in the UK.
awardAmount: Full university tuition fees + monthly stipend + round-trip economy flights + arrival allowance (~£35,000+)
applicationInstructions: Submit application through online Chevening system. Provide 4 essays (Leadership, Networking, Studying in the UK, Career Plan) and 3 eligible UK university choices.
requirements: Citizen of India with commitment to return to India for minimum 2 years post-study
Completed undergraduate degree equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours (approx 65%+)
Minimum of two years (equivalent to 2,800 hours) of professional work/internship experience
Apply to 3 eligible UK university courses and receive an unconditional offer

name: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) for SC/ST Candidates
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Enabling low-income students belonging to SC, de-notified nomadic tribes, and traditional artisans to pursue Master's and PhD programs abroad.
awardAmount: Full tuition fees + living allowance ($15,400/yr in USA, £9,900/yr in UK) + airfare
applicationInstructions: Register on the NOS portal with caste certificate, income certificate issued by Tehsildar, and unconditional admission offer from a top 500 QS ranked university.
requirements: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Denotified Nomadic Tribes, or landless agricultural labor category
Total family income from all sources must be less than ₹8,00,000 per annum
Secured admission in top 500 QS World Ranked foreign universities
Minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in qualifying degree

name: Tata Trusts Medical and Healthcare Scholarships
description: Merit-cum-means financial grant for deserving students pursuing Bachelor's or Master's in Medical and Healthcare disciplines in India.
awardAmount: Covers 30% to 80% of institutional tuition fees
applicationInstructions: Apply online through Tata Trusts portal with college fee receipts, previous marksheets, and family income proof.
requirements: Enrolled in a recognized medical college in India for MBBS, BDS, Nursing, or allied health fields
Completed 1st year with minimum 65% aggregate score
Family annual income under ₹6 Lakhs INR
Verification of tuition fee receipt and bonafide student status

name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Public Policy & Good Governance)
description: Supports future leaders from developing countries who want to promote democracy and social justice through Master's degrees in Germany.
awardAmount: Tuition-free Master's + €934/month stipend + health insurance + travel subsidies + German language course
applicationInstructions: Submit application to up to two participating Master courses at German universities with DAAD application form and motivation essay.
requirements: First higher education degree in political science, law, economics, or social sciences
Degree completed no more than 6 years before the application deadline
Solid English proficiency (e.g. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90)
Clear civic engagement, political or community leadership interest

name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's and Doctoral Fellowships
description: Prestige scholarships for outstanding Indian citizens to pursue Master's or research degrees at selected US colleges and universities.
awardAmount: J-1 visa support, round-trip economy air travel, tuition fees, living stipend, and accident & sickness coverage
applicationInstructions: Apply online through the Fulbright Foreign Student Program portal with 3 reference letters, study/research objectives, and personal statement.
requirements: Must have completed an equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree (minimum 4-year degree or Master's)
Minimum 55% marks in highest degree
Minimum three years of full-time professional work experience relevant to field
Demonstrated leadership qualities and commitment to return to India

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice / Ministry of Tribal Affairs / State Governments
description: Centrally sponsored scheme operated through State governments to support students from disadvantaged groups pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
awardAmount: Full non-refundable tuition reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/yr
applicationInstructions: Apply via state scholarship portal or NSP with caste certificate issued by SDM/Tehsildar and college bonafide certificate.
requirements: Must hold a valid caste certificate (SC, ST, or eligible OBC)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakhs (₹1.5 Lakhs for some state OBC brackets)
Enrolled in a recognized post-matric course in an accredited educational institution
Satisfactory attendance and academic progression

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees (EMJMD)
description: High-level integrated international study programmes, delivered by an international consortium of higher education institutions across Europe.
awardAmount: 100% participation costs covered + €1,400/month living allowance + travel installation costs (~€49,000)
applicationInstructions: Consult EMJM catalogue, apply directly to the consortium delivering the joint Master programme through its dedicated website.
requirements: Completed a first higher education degree or demonstrated equivalent level of learning
Open to students from any country with high academic standing
Must study in at least two different European programme countries during the degree
No restriction on family income

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme
description: Educational Crisis Support Scholarship assisting meritorious and economically vulnerable students facing personal or financial hardships.
awardAmount: Up to ₹75,000 per year (depending on education level)
applicationInstructions: Apply online through the HDFC Parivartan scholarship portal with previous year marksheets and income certificate.
requirements: Indian national enrolled in Class 1 to 12, diploma, UG or PG courses
Passed previous academic year with at least 55% marks
Annual household income less than or equal to ₹2,50,000
Preference to students facing crises (loss of breadwinner, medical emergencies)

name: Aditya Birla Capital Scholarship
description: Financial support to help school and university students complete their ongoing education despite financial constraints.
applicationInstructions: Apply online with current college admission proof, income certificate, and previous marksheets.
requirements: Open to students from Class 9 to graduation (general & professional streams)
Minimum 60% marks in previous academic year
Annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000
Children of employees of Aditya Birla Group are not eligible
